about: The curated, local catalogue the self-evolution module may propose from. It is read from disk only; planning never touches the network. Every dependency carries its licence, and the validator's licence check decides whether an entry may be proposed at all.

entries.name: kafka
entries.why: the task needs a Kafka consumer; no installed pack covers message queues

entries.name: graph
entries.why: the task needs graph algorithms (paths, centrality); no installed pack covers them

entries.name: rss
entries.why: the task reads RSS or Atom feeds; the http pack fetches bytes but does not parse feeds

entries.name: pdf
entries.why: the task reads PDF documents; no installed pack extracts their text

entries.name: redis
entries.why: the task talks to Redis; no installed pack covers it

entries.name: priced-feed
entries.why: an example of what is never proposed: a proprietary SDK behind a paid account
